name: Orka
summary: A small Chadra-Fan who does the bargaining at the Office of Acquisitions, the Colossus salvage shop he runs with his partner Flix, Orka loves a joke and a good lunch. He trades Kaz spare parts for a gorg, drops a robber through the shop's trapdoor, and on Drahgor III stands up to Flix's family until they share their fuel.

name: Sistros Nevet
affiliation: Four Sages of Dwartii; Galactic Republic
summary: One of Dwartii's four famed Sages, Sistros Nevet is a cold, calculating minister and lawmaker who helps write the constitution of the modern Republic and is accused of shaping it for her own ends. A thousand years later Palpatine admires her: her statue stands in his office, hides his lightsabers, and follows him into the Imperial Palace.

name: Fives
summary: A clone from Domino Squad who scrapes through training on Kamino, Fives lives through the raid on Rishi Station, joins the 501st Legion and earns ARC trooper rank. After his friend Tup kills a Jedi on command, he digs out the secret of the inhibitor chips, and Commander Fox shoots him before anyone will listen.
